articles.body: Two people can type a similar idea into an AI video generator and get very different results. One gets a smooth, cinematic shot. The other gets a wobbly clip where nothing seems to happen. The difference is almost always the prompt. This guide collects practical text-to-video prompting techniques that consistently help, with before-and-after examples. You can try them on Pixwit's text-to-video generator , which lets you run the same prompt across several models, but the ideas carry over to almost any modern video model. 1. Think like a director, not a novelist Video models respond best to concrete, visual instructions. Skip backstory and emotion you can't see. Describe what the camera sees and how it moves.

articles.title: The pipeline problem: false claims are easy to train on
articles.excerpt: The pipeline problem: false claims are easy to train on A language model does not know that a statistic is true because it has a citation, a polished chart, or a confident sentence around it. If a fal…
articles.body: The pipeline problem: false claims are easy to train on A language model does not know that a statistic is true because it has a citation, a polished chart, or a confident sentence around it. If a false number appears often enough in material that enters the training mixture, the model can learn it as a plausible continuation—and later reproduce it with the style of an established fact. The model is learning relationships among tokens and contexts, not independently checking the world described by those tokens. That is the concrete problem behind reports of fabricated statistics being cited by language models. A number can acquire an appearance of authority as it moves through articles, summaries, social posts, and other derivative material.

articles.title: Request-scoped logging in Node.js and Express at Oizom
articles.excerpt: When an API call fails with a 500 in production, I want one id from the response and, behind it, every log line that request wrote, in order. At Oizom every request gets a context id, every function l…
articles.body: When an API call fails with a 500 in production, I want one id from the response and, behind it, every log line that request wrote, in order. At Oizom every request gets a context id, every function logs through context.log , and the logs of a request are only kept when it fails or the frontend asks for them. I'm Panth, and I lead the software team at Oizom, where our devices send tens of thousands of air-quality readings to the cloud every minute. This post is how that logging works in our Node.js and Express backends, with the code. Hosted logging services can collect all of this, but none of them group logs by request out of the box, and running a separate service per request is not an option. The problem A client makes a request and the API answers with a 500.

Then omniroute launch --profile auto-coding-free starts Claude Code through OmniRoute. articles.body: Finnish Counter-Strike 2 pro Aleksi “Aleksib” Virolainen is facing a possible four-month suspended prison sentence over alleged “aggravated tax fraud” after failing to declare income from in-game sticker sales. In Counter-Strike 2 , players can purchase virtual stickers and place them on their weapons. They are an in-game item that can be bought on the Steam Marketplace, the CS2 Store, or in capsules, as well as through third-party websites. It’s not uncommon for professional teams to get a cut of the money earned from sticker sales and other in-game purchases when they compete at major tournaments — and it’s this revenue that prosecutors say Virolainen failed to include on his tax forms.

articles.title: On this day in space! Oct. 20, 1970: The Soviet Union launches last-ever Zond moon mission
articles.excerpt: On Oct. 20, 1970, the Soviet Union launched the Zond 8 spacecraft on a mission to the moon. Here's why it mattered.
articles.body: On Oct. 20, 1970, the Soviet Union launched the Zond 8 spacecraft on a mission to the moon. This was the last mission in the Zond program. After the first three Zond missions explored Venus and Mars , the next ones were circumlunar missions that flew around the moon before returning to Earth. Although there was no crew on board, the Zond spacecraft was designed with cosmonauts in mind. The Zond missions served as test flights for the Soviet Union's plans to send cosmonauts to the moon. But those plans for crewed flights never came to fruition. This was partly because the U.S. had already put astronauts on the moon , but also because the Zond missions had a lot of technical problems. Zond 8 was considered a success — even though its guidance system malfunctioned on the way back to Earth.
